Collection Date.Description: Date and Time of data collection.

behavior_missing_stimulus_markers.Description: List of missing markers in Stimulus stream in the xdf file. Compares stimulus markers in the xdf with event dictionary and outputs list of missing markers in the xdf.

behavior_total_duration.Description: Total duration of the experiment. Calculated by getting the difference between the lsl timestamps of the first and last event triggers.

behavior_unexpected_durations.Description: List of events that are not of expected length. Compares duration of story listening events with presented audio file duration and outputs a list of event that have lengths different from that of audio files.
behavior_unexpected_durations.Print Name: Durations do not match expected length

behavior_impedance_check_duration.Description: Duration of Impedance check. Calculated from impedance check markers in the xdf file.

behavior_ten_seconds_rest.Description: Check for equal 10 seconds rest between story listenign sessions. Each rest duration is calculated from stimulus markers and checked whether all equate to 10s.

behavior_average_response_time.Description: Average duration of question-answer session after story listening. Duration for each question-answer session is calculated from stimulus triggers and then the average is computed.
behavior_average_response_time.Print Name: Average response time across all story listening task

et_left_gaze_point_invalid.Print Name: Percent invalid data in left gaze point

et_xyz_measures_check.Print Name: Flag: all coordinates have the same % validity within each measure (LR, gaze point/origin/diameter)

et_coordinate_system_check.Print Name: Flag: % of NaNs is the same between coordinate systems (UCS and TBCS (gaze origin) and between UCS and display area (gaze point))

et_LR_mean_diff.Print Name: Mean difference in percent valid data between right and left eyes

et_percent_over02.Print Name: Percent of data with gaze point differences of over 0.2 mm
